title: Agency Agents tool registry
description: Shape of `tools.json`, the bundled mirror of the canonical catalog manifest the upstream `agency-agents` repo owns. One entry per supported AI coding tool, keyed by the CLI tool name (kebab-case). The schema encodes the authoring contract only — installability is derived app-side from `format` + `installKind` and is intentionally NOT part of the manifest.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference. Allowed so the canonical upstream manifest can adopt `$schema` without breaking app-side validation; the app mirror omits it to stay a verbatim copy.

_note.description: Free-form maintainer notes: what the manifest is, how adding a tool works, and which scripts/CI gate it.

tools.description: Every supported tool, keyed by its kebab-case CLI name. The key MUST equal the entry's `kebab` field (enforced semantically, not by JSON Schema).

tool.description: One tool's install contract plus its app presentation. The install contract (`id`, `label`, `kebab`, `format`, `installKind`, `dest`) is what the catalog's tool checker gates; `short`, `accent`, `scope`, `detect`, `version` and `order` are the fields both app consumers (Rust registry + frontend) read. Everything except `order`, `icon`, `slugFrom` and `slugPrefix` is required.

id.description: camelCase wire id used by the frontend and the install ledger (e.g. "claudeCode"). Unique across the catalog.

label.description: Full display name shown in the UI (e.g. "Claude Code").

short.description: Compact name for dense UIs such as the tool coverage matrix (e.g. "Claude").

kebab.description: kebab-case CLI id used by the install scripts and as the `tools` map key.

accent.description: Badge accent color as a 6-digit hex string (e.g. "#D97757").

icon.description: Brand-mark filename stem under `assets/tools/` (e.g. "claudecode" → claudecode.svg), or null to fall back to the letter mark.

order.description: Optional install-menu position. Entries without an order sort after ordered ones, by label (both consumers treat a missing order that way).

scope.description: Which install scopes the tool supports.

user.description: True when the tool installs user-globally (paths rooted at $HOME).

project.description: True when the tool installs per-project (paths rooted at the project root).

detect.description: Hints used to decide whether the tool is already present on this machine.

dirs.description: Relative directories whose presence implies the tool is installed. Empty when detection is not directory-based.

items.description: Relative directory, e.g. ".claude" or ".config/opencode". Must not be absolute or escape the home/project root.

agentsDir.description: The directory the tool reads agent definitions from, or null when it has none (roster/plugin tools).

version.description: `<bin> <args…>` probe used to read the installed tool version.

format.description: Renderer contract: the same `format` name guarantees byte-identical output, so two tools may share a format only if their rendered files are identical. Known values include identity, codex-toml, gemini-md, qwen-md, zcode-md, cursor-mdc, opencode-md, antigravity-md, skill-md, aider-conventions, kimi-agent, openclaw-workspace, windsurf-rules, vibe-toml and hermes-router-plugin; new formats are allowed (renderer coverage is the consumer's concern).

installKind.description: Install mechanism (upstream truth): per-agent = one rendered file/dir per agent; roster = one combined file for all agents; plugin = a built artifact that is not per-agent renderable (CLI-only everywhere).

slugFrom.description: "source" keeps the corpus filename as the output slug; "name" slugifies the frontmatter name; null for single-file roster formats, which have no per-agent slug.

slugPrefix.description: Namespace prepended to the output slug AND the rendered `name` field — "agency-" for skill-directory tools that share a global skills folder. Omit for tools that need no prefix.

dest.description: Destination path templates, relative to $HOME (user scope) or the project root (project scope). `{slug}` is substituted at install time. At least one scope must declare a destination.

user.description: Files/directories written for user scope (empty when the tool does not support it).

project.description: Files/directories written for project scope (empty when the tool does not support it).

items.description: Relative destination template, e.g. ".claude/agents/{slug}.md". Must not be absolute or escape the scope root.
